input.summary: Give the Company a 30-day convenience termination right without penalty
input.comment: [Playbook] We require a convenience exit on 30 days' notice without penalty, while HDI's right should not disrupt a committed term. We have set our notice period at 30 days (HDI retains 90 days, effective at the end of a term) and confirmed no termination payment or other charge applies to our exit.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company for convenience upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company effective no earlier than the end of the then-current term.

input.summary: Shorten the non-renewal window to 30 days and add an HDI renewal reminder
input.comment: [Playbook] A 90-day non-renewal window is at the outer edge of what we accept. We have added a 30-day opt-out for us plus a 60-day renewal reminder from HDI, keeping renewal terms at 12 months.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, each renewal term shall be twelve (12) months; HDI shall notify the Company in writing not less than sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term of the upcoming renewal; and the Company may elect not to renew by written notice to HDI given not less than thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term, without penalty or further charge.
